class XI myosin motors are required for development, cell expansion, and F-actins organization in Arabidopsis.

the role of the myosin motor proteins in plant cell growth and development.
the function of the myosin motors in plant cells and their role in the organization of the cell.
the function of class XI myosin genes in the growth of plants.

the myosins play a crucial role in plant development, cell expansion and F-actins organization.
myosins play a crucial role during polarized cell growth, and their loss results in severe defects during plant growth and development.
myosins XI play a critical role during plant development, cell expansion, and F-actins organization.

myosins XI are required for cell expansion, cell morphogenesis, plant development, and F-actins organization.
myosins play a central role in the growth of plant tissues, organs, and whole plants, in part by controlling F-actin-based cell expansion.
the actin cytoskeleton and the associated motor proteins play critical roles during cell growth and plant morphogenesis.

the myosin motors and their actin tracks are essential for plant cell growth, plant development, and proper organization of cell interior.
